name: Creamy Tuscan Tofu, Spinach & Tomato Sauté with Roasted Potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb new potatoes
½ pint grape tomatoes
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Halve potatoes. Transfer to another baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place potatoes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring once, until golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu. Place in a medium bowl, sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then gently toss to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry, turning occasionally, until browned and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Return crispy tofu to the bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
While the tofu is cooking, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and tomatoes; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
When the onion and tomato are done, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Place in the reserved bowl, setting aside a small handful for serving.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the Parmesan.
Add Parmesan, basil, cream, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and sauce is combined, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz (½ cup) heavy whipping cream
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return tofu to the skillet with the sauce and gently stir to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide creamy tofu sauté and potatoes between plates or bowls. Top with reserved Parmesan and enjoy!
